articles.title: Smaller tokens lead as bitcoin, sol rally in 'first real bounce of the selloff'
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies rebounded on dovish Federal Reserve signals, with speculative tokens like Memecore’s M and Audiera’s BEAT leading gains.

articles.title: Analyst warns BTC could drop further after worst June since 2022
articles.snippet: The June close above realized price but below the 200-week moving average “signals the bear bottom is still ahead per prior cycles,” one analyst said.

articles.title: Tradeweb executes real-time tokenized US Treasury transaction on Canton Network
articles.snippet: Franklin Templeton transferred a tokenized US Treasury to Virtu Financial in what Tradeweb said was the first real-time transaction settled against USDCx.
